program.name: Refugee Cash Assistance (RCA)
program.description:
Refugee Cash Assistance (RCA) gives monthly cash to refugees and other newcomers.

In Kansas, RCA is run by the Kansas Office for Refugees (KSOR). You may get RCA for up to 8 months. The 8 months start on the date you became eligible for refugee benefits, if that date is on or after January 1, 2026. KSOR will also review your income when deciding if you qualify.

Kansas does not publish its RCA payment amounts. The amount shown here is an estimate based on Kansas TANF payments. Your actual payment may be different.

Select "Contact Local Agency" to find a Kansas agency you can call about applying.
